# Tutiq — Your AI Tutor That Adapts to You
> https://tutiq.app

Tutiq is a free AI-powered personal tutor at tutiq.app. It generates personalised step-by-step explanations for any subject — Maths, Science, English, History, Geography, Coding, Languages, Interview Prep and more — adapting language and difficulty to the learner's age and level.

## Free Tier
- 3 tutoring sessions per day
- No sign-up or credit card required
- 3 subjects included

## Pro Plan ($8/month)
- Unlimited sessions
- All subjects unlocked
- Progress tracking
- PDF study guides
- Mock exam mode
- Priority AI responses

## Who It's For
- GCSE students (Year 9-11) — AQA, Edexcel, OCR aligned
- 11+ Prep students (Age 9-11) — CEM and GL Assessment formats
- Adults and graduates — interview prep (FAANG, NHS, Law)
- Anyone wanting to learn any topic

## How It Works
1. Pick a subject and tell us your age and level
2. Tutiq AI builds a personalised step-by-step learning path
3. Study bite-sized explanations with a quiz after each topic

## Key Features
- Adaptive difficulty — explanations match your age and level automatically
- Quiz after every topic — cement what you've learned
- Instant answers — no waiting, 24/7 availability
- Works on any device — no download required

## Technology
- Built with Next.js 15 and Tailwind CSS
- AI: Groq -> Gemini -> Anthropic fallback chain
- Domain: tutiq.app
